_comment: Performance regression baseline for @vytches/ddd-nestjs (VP-006b / AC5). Update after intentional optimisations by running `pnpm --filter @vytches/ddd-nestjs bench` and committing new baseline values. PRIMARY metrics are COUNT-based (logged to stdout by the bench files), not wall-clock.

cold_production_moduleRef_get.description: Cold resolve of N internally-registered services with NODE_ENV=production must invoke moduleRef.get exactly 0 times (registry-first, OQ-1/A)

cold_production_moduleRef_throws.description: No ModuleRef not-found throws on the production hot path for internally-owned tokens

cold_getMetadata_per_constructor.description: Reflect.getMetadata('design:paramtypes') must be read exactly ONCE per constructor on cold resolve (lazy-once cache, D-1)

cold_dev_moduleRef_get_per_token.description: With NODE_ENV != production the dual-registration divergence guard probes moduleRef exactly once per token (post-audit OQ-4 condition)

warm_deltas.description: Warm resolve x1000 (production): moduleRef.get, throw, and Reflect.getMetadata deltas must all be 0

unknown_token_moduleRef_get.description: A fully-unknown token costs exactly ONE moduleRef.get (single-pass resolveOrMiss, D-3 — no isRegistered+resolve double lookup)

mean_createScope_ms_at_n1000.description: AC4 materiality threshold: mean createScope() must stay < 0.5 ms at N=1000 registered services, else move to copy-on-write (OQ-2)

retained_kb_per_live_scope_at_n1000.description: AC4 materiality threshold: avg additional retained heap per live scope must stay < 50 KB at N=1000, else move to copy-on-write (OQ-2)

warmed_singleton_us_per_op.description: Warmed singleton root resolve through the adapter (registry hit + singleton cache) should stay < 2 µs/op

warmed_transient_depth5_us_per_op.description: Warmed transient depth-5 chain resolve (5 instantiations via cached paramtypes) should stay < 10 µs/op

notes: Benchmarks use a counting stub ModuleRef, NOT a booted NestJS app — NestJS bootstrap wall-clock is deliberately out of scope (D-4).
Count metrics are deterministic; timing/heap metrics are environment-sensitive — run 3+ times and take the median.
Heap deltas are approximate: process.memoryUsage() reflects the whole heap. Run node with --expose-gc for stable numbers.
results.json (generated by vitest bench --outputJson) and history/ are git-ignored; only this baseline is tracked.
